nodes.name: Pt/C
aliases: high surface area carbon-supported platinum nanoparticles

nodes.name: Pt/C thin-film electrode preparation
nodes.procedure: Aqueous suspensions of Pt/C of ∼0.15 mg/mL were obtained by dispersing the catalyst in deionized (DI) water (18.2 MΩ cm, Millipore) using ultrasonication of the suspension in an ice bath. 20 μL of the Pt/C catalyst water suspension was deposited on a glassy carbon electrode (GCE) disk (5 mm diameter, Pine Instruments), which was polished with 0.05 μm alumina (Buehler), and dried in air at room temperature, resulting in a Pt loading of ∼7.0 μg_Pt/cm² on GCE.

nodes.name: Pt(pc) electrode cleaning
nodes.procedure: The Pt(pc) disk electrode (5 mm in diameter, Pine Instruments) was also polished with 0.05 μm alumina and was cleaned by ultrasonication in DI water.

nodes.name: Luggin capillary modification
nodes.procedure: We also modified the Luggin capillary, replacing the highly KOH-soluble Vycor glass tip of the Luggin capillary with a 50 μm thick Nafion film.

nodes.description: HOR/HER comparison in 0.1 M HClO4 using RDE

observation.value: kinetics limited entirely by hydrogen diffusion

nodes.source_text: Unlike the HOR/HER rates on Pt electrodes in alkaline solution, the HOR/HER rates on a Pt electrode in 0.1 M HClO4 were limited entirely by hydrogen diffusion, which renders the quantification of the HOR/HER kinetics impossible by conventional RDE measurements.

nodes.characterization_summary: Average Pt nanoparticle diameter of Pt/C determined by transmission electron microscopy was 2.0 ± 0.6 nm based on at least 200 particle counts.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The average Pt nanoparticle (NP) diameter of the Pt/C determined by transmission electron microscopy was 2.0 ± 0.6 nm based on at least 200 particle counts.

nodes.characterization_summary: Pt(pc) roughness factor determined from H adsorption/desorption region after double-layer correction was ~1.6 cm_Pt^2 / cm_disk^2.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The thus obtained roughness factor of the Pt(pc) disk from four independent experiments... was ~1.6 ± 0.2 cm_Pt^2 / cm_disk^2.

nodes.characterization_summary: Pt/C specific surface area determined from double-layer corrected Pt–H underpotential deposition region was 62 m^2 / g_Pt, corresponding to roughness factor of 4.3 cm_Pt^2 / cm_disk^2.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Using the double-layer-corrected Pt–H underpotential deposition region, the specific surface area of Pt/C was determined to be 62 m^2 / g_Pt, corresponding to a roughness factor of 4.3 cm_Pt^2 / cm_disk^2 for thin-film RDE electrodes of Pt/C.

nodes.characterization_summary: AC impedance spectroscopy used to measure cell resistance (65 Ω at 275 K, 35 Ω at 314 K) for iR correction of HOR/HER kinetics on both catalysts.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The cell resistance was measured immediately after RDE measurements using VoltaMaster (Voltlab), taking the ac impedance spectra from 32 to 0.1 kHz... The solution resistances measured at 275 and 314 K were 65 and 35 Ω, respectively.
